name: Tjolöholm - Åsa
description: Tjolöholm to Åsa. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Toalett Gårda Brygga: Official seasonal toilet and drinking-water point at Gårda Brygga; open 15/5-15/9 according to official place text.
Toalett Vita Sand Åsa: Official seasonal toilet and drinking-water point at Åsa/Vita Sand endpoint; text says accessible toilet, shower and foot shower.
notes: Default places API call returned 20 records and omitted Åsa Jutegård Bed & Breakfast; limit=100 returned 21 records.

Official page/API display 29 km and API length_in_meters is 29000. GPX desc says Total: 28.7 km. Official GPX/API flattened length is about 28.787 km, while segment-sum without gap bridges is about 28.474 km.
Official GPX/API geo_json is multipart with two gaps of about 202.6 m and 110.7 m. Flattening the GPX as one continuous LineString creates artificial connectors across those gaps.
Hallandsleden section-specific API geo_json exactly matches the official GPX, but line.geometry is missing.
Rendered official page says Grön/Green/easy; one API pass returned degree_of_difficulty easy, while lane check noted API difficulty field null in another projection.

Official K3 prose says the route turns inland to avoid the bird-protection area south of Tjolöholm. Kungsbackafjorden rules include seasonal access bans in seven mapped subareas, but no vector subarea overlap was proven.
